Do you enjoy turning complex data into meaningful insights that support better business decisions? Are you motivated by working at the intersection of finance, operations, and strategy?

As a Business Controller in Operations Finance, you will play a key role in supporting financial and operational performance across our global operations organization. Working closely with colleagues in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Commercial and Finance, you will help create transparency, challenge assumptions and provide the insights needed to support business decisions across the value chain.

The role combines financial analysis, performance management and business partnering. You will transform data into actionable recommendations, support management reporting and forecasting processes, and contribute to continuous improvements that strengthen operational and financial performance across the organization.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Drive monthly performance reporting and provide insights into financial and operational results

• Analyses performance against budget and forecast, identify key trends, and explain business impacts

• Support forecasting and budgeting processes in close collaboration with stakeholders across the business

• Assess risks, opportunities and improvement initiatives to support decision-making

• Develop reporting tools, dashboards and performance measures that increase transparency and strengthen business insights

• Contribute to continuous improvements of reporting processes, forecasting accuracy and data quality

**What You Bring

**

• A degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Experience in Business Controlling, FP&A, Operations Finance or a similar analytical role

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of financial planning, forecasting and performance management

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• The ability to communicate complex information clearly and build strong relationships across functions

• A structured and proactive approach combined with a genuine interest in improving processes and creating business value

**What We Offer

**You will join an international environment where finance is a key partner to the business and where collaboration across functions is essential to success. The role offers broad exposure to operations, supply chain and commercial performance, giving you the opportunity to develop both your financial expertise and your business understanding.

You will work with experienced colleagues, gain visibility across the organization and can influence decision-making through data-driven insights. At the same time, you will become part of a team that values curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Ready to apply?

We know that great candidates do not always meet every requirement. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe you can contribute to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Ready to make an impact?

**Please submit your CV no later than October 31, 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, with first- and second-round interviews beginning in week 47 (November 16–22, 2026).

For questions about the position, please contact Senior Finance Partner, Linda Bartha, at ldna@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About Demant

**Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions and expertise to help people hear better. From hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment, services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged across the hearing healthcare industry. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries, where we create life-changing hearing health solutions as well as high-end audio and video solutions. The William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and is among the 25 most traded stocks.

jobs.description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Senior Manager Of Customer Experience & Product At AtNorth

**Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

**Your profile:

**We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Excellent communication, facilitation and executive-level reporting skills.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Product Management, Service Management, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish is preferred.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

**About The AtNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

**Do you want to know more?

**In this process atNorth is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Christian Smith at +46 8 120 50 400.

We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Overview

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Planning is an individual contributor focused on supporting Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) in the effective management of clinical trial timelines across the portfolio. The role drives planning system enablement (Planisware), owns and maintains a standardized Microsoft Project (MSP) trial planning template, and develops high-quality timeline visualizations to support trial execution and governance decision-making.

The role partners closely with Global Trial Leaders (GTLs), who are accountable for the overall delivery of their trials and retain ownership of trial timelines within internal planning systems. The Clinical Trial Planner complements this accountability by ensuring planning data is structured, standardized, and translated into clear, actionable insights that enable effective execution and decision-making.

**Responsibilities/tasks

****Planisware Enablement & Trial Support

**

• Partner with GTLs across the portfolio to drive effective use of Planisware and ensure trial plans reflect agreed assumptions, dependencies, and execution strategy, while GTLs retain overall accountability.

• Liaise with Development Program Managers (DPMs) to align trial-level plans with program- and asset-level timelines and milestones.

• Collaborate with the Portfolio Planning team to provide structured trial-level insights and recommendations that inform ongoing refinement and maintenance of Planisware templates and standards.

**MS Project (MSP) Template Ownership & Standardization

**

• Develop and maintain a fit for purpose Microsoft Project (MSP) Trial Planning template for GTL use across study phases.

• Ensure alignment between the MSP template, Planisware, and portfolio-level planning standards.

• Provide guidance to GTLs to promote consistent, high-quality timeline development using the MSP template.

**Data Visualization

**

• Develop and deliver clear visualization templates derived from Planisware and/or MSP data, displaying key milestones and activities.

• Tailor visual outputs to support CTTs, governance, and leadership discussions.

**Process & Tool Adoption

**

• Act as a Planisware subject matter expert at the trial-support level.

• Reinforce GTL training through hands-on guidance and real-time coaching.

• Apply and promote standardized planning methodologies and visualization standards across the portfolio.

**Governance Awareness & Decision Support

**

• Prepare timeline views and supporting materials aligned with governance forum expectations (e.g., Project Board, Portfolio Board, Operational Review Committee).

• Anticipate governance triggers based on timeline changes or emerging risks.

• Translate planning data into concise, decision-ready visuals and summaries.

**Requirements/Preferences

****Senior Manager

**

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Approximately 7-10+ years of experience in clinical trial operations, project management, trial planning, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience driving planning system adoption and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience developing or standardizing planning templates, tools, or reporting frameworks across multiple studies.

• Strong understanding of portfolio-level planning considerations and governance expectations.

• Advanced analytical capability and ability to provide structured execution insight to leadership forums.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

jobs.occupation: Dynamic flood exposure in Denmark: where will people live when the water comes?
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Environmental Science programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Dynamic flood exposure in Denmark: where will people live when the water comes?

Research area and project description
The overarching aim of this PhD project is to understand how flood exposure in Denmark evolves over time as a result of household location decisions, and to make that dynamic available for cost–benefit analysis of climate adaptation. This is a quantitative PhD: the work combines applied econometrics on Danish register and property-transaction data, a discrete choice experiment, and agent-based simulation modelling. The project is co-financed by the Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) and Aarhus University, and the PhD student will be part of the research environments at both institutions.

The project in a nutshell: Cost–benefit analyses of flood adaptation in Denmark evaluate investments over horizons of 80–100 years, yet they treat the spatial distribution of people, buildings and assets as fixed at today's values. Over the coming decades, urban development, demographic change and the gradual repricing of flood risk by insurers, banks and public authorities will reshape who lives in flood-prone areas and what is at risk. At the same time, Danish evidence suggests that flood risk is only weakly reflected in property prices and settlement patterns – households appear to locate under incomplete information about the risk they face. This PhD project treats flood exposure as an emergent outcome of household behavior rather than a fixed physical quantity, and develops an agent-based model of household location decisions under bounded rationality that can project exposure to 2075 under alternative scenarios for institutional risk signals: business as usual, insurance repricing, tighter mortgage lending, and full information.

Qualifications and specific competences
Required qualifications:
• An M.Sc. in economics or spatial data analyses or a closely related quantitative field
• Training in econometrics and experience with R, Python or Stata
• Good written and oral EnglishIt is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have:
• Experience with panel data, difference-in-differences, hedonic analysis or discrete choice modelling
• Experience with large administrative datasets, e.g. Danmarks Statistik registers
• Experience with or curiosity about agent-based modelling
• Reading proficiency in DanishWe do not expect any candidate to have all of these requirements. The PhD programme includes training in register data, choice experiment design and agent-based modelling, and you will be supervised closely throughout the scholarship. If you have a solid quantitative foundation and are interested in the questions, we encourage you to apply. The role of the PhD student in this project will be particularly focused on the following objectives: 1) a register-based analysis of who lives in flood-prone areas in Denmark and how residential mobility responds to flood events, using Danmarks Statistik microdata linked to building and flood hazard data; 2) a hedonic price analysis of the extent to which flood risk is capitalized in Danish property prices, including event studies around major flood events; 3) a discrete choice experiment estimating how households respond to explicit risk information and to changed signals from insurers, banks and public authorities; and 4) the integration of these results into an agent-based model that simulates exposure trajectories under alternative institutional scenarios and delivers inputs for flood cost–benefit analysis.

The PhD student will enter a research environment with a strong focus on climate adaptation. At the Department of Environmental Science, the student will join the Environmental Social Science and Geography section, which works on environmental valuation, flood damage modelling and the economics of climate adaptation. At DMI, the student will be part of the National Center for Climate Research that produce Danish flood hazard data and climate projections for decision-making at national and municipal levels in Denmark. The student will have office space at both institutions and is expected to take part in the daily research life at both.
You must upload a project description about how you intend to approach the objectives of the project.

Project description (½–4 pages): This document should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate a URL where further information can be found, but the description should be self-contained.

Qualifications and specific competences: The ideal candidate is highly motivated candidate with an M.Sc. degree with specialization in economics and spatial data analyses, or closely related quantitative fields. Demonstrated oral and written communication skills in English are required. The applicant is expected to present results at international conferences and publish them in international peer-reviewed journals. The applicant should be interested in working in an international and interdisciplinary academic environment. The following qualifications are an advantage, but we do not expect any candidate to have them all:

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Environmental Science, Frederiksborgvej 399, Aarhus University, 4000 Roskilde, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Senior Researcher Toke Emil Panduro, e-mail: toke@envs.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Researcher Karsten Arnbjerg Nielsen, e-mail: kan@dmi.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 15 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 January 2027.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most. 
 

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. 

About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

• 
Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

• 
Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

• 
Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

• 
Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

• 
Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

• 
Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum. 
 

What you will bring: 

• 
10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

• 
A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

• 
Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

• 
Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

• 
An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

• 
A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity.
 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit.

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. jobs.occupation: Postdoc in RNA Biomarkers and Extracellular Vesicle Biology
jobs.description:
Department of Science and Environment, Roskilde University, invites applications as post-doctoral fellow in RNA cell biology from April 1st or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Description of the post-doc project
A fully funded postdoc position (18 months) at Roskilde University in the research group of Professor Dalgaard, funded by Danmarks Frie Forskningsfond (Independent Research Fund Denmark) through the project "Enabling RNA Biomarker Origin Detection by Multiplexing Extracellular Tracing". The project will develop a multiplexed extracellular RNA (exRNA)-tracing platform capable of identifying the cell-of-origin of secreted RNAs in plasma and cell media samples and will demonstrate its use by tracing RNA released by pancreatic islet cells and adipose tissue, both highly relevant to type 2 diabetes (T2D) and obesity. The platform will be valuable for validating novel RNA biomarkers and for discovering RNA-based therapeutic targets in metabolic disease.

Responsibilities and tasks
The postdoc’s work will include research within ExRNA biology, RNA biomarker discovery, and multi-omics profiling, with focus on tracing the cellular origin of secreted RNAs relevant to type 2 diabetes and metabolic disease. In addition, some amount of teaching is also required. 

The ideal candidate is expected to:

• Lead the development and validation of a multiplexed exRNA-tracing platform, based on integration of bio-orthogonal proximity labeling and metabolic RNA labeling systems.
• Perform in vitro and in vivo tracing experiments in pancreatic islet cells, adipose cells, and other relevant cell models to determine the cellular origin of secreted extracellular RNAs and extracellular vesicles (EVs).
• Apply proteomics and small RNA sequencing/omics approaches to characterize the RNA and protein cargo of pancreatic islet- and adipose-derived extracellular vesicles and biofluid samples.
• Analyze and validate candidate RNA biomarkers relevant to T2D and metabolic disease, using plasma and other biofluid samples from relevant cohorts or models.
• Mentor younger or graduate students within the focus of the research project.
Qualifications
Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent within cell biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related field. Qualifications within the following scientific areas are required:

The ideal candidate has an outstanding track record of accomplishments and a critical mindset. Moreover, an open mentality with focus on research communication, inter-disciplinary curiosity and teamwork will be required to succeed. Moreover, the following qualifications are relevant:

• Certified training in laboratory animal research is required.
• Advanced experimental experience in RNA biology and/or extracellular vesicle (EV) biology is required
• Hands-on experience with proteomics and/or small RNA sequencing or other omics-based biomarker profiling techniques is required.
• Experience with research in metabolic disease, in particular type 2 diabetes or obesity, and/or experience working with pancreatic islets or other metabolically relevant primary cells/tissues, will be highly valuable.
• Experience with publication of original relevant scientific data in peer-reviewed journals will be an advantage.
The ideal candidate should be enterprising and possess good communication skills, be visible and involved in the department’s daily activities, in addition to being willing to engage in disciplinary and interdisciplinary collaboration across the department and with project collaborators.

Assessment
In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to;

• Experience and qualifications as stated above.
• Academic excellence and scientific production relevant to the description above.
• The ability to promote and utilize research results.
• Experience in mentorship and teaching.
• Ability to communicate in written and spoken English.
• Ability to contribute to development of the department’s internal and external cooperations.
The Department of Science and Environment
Department of Science and Environment is one of four departments at Roskilde University. The Department conducts basic and applied research within medical biology, molecular biology, chemistry, physics, environmental sciences, and mathematics. Bachelor programs are offered within these areas, as are interdisciplinary Master programs. The Department’s laboratories are equipped with modern infrastructure and shared state-of-the art instrumentation. This includes recently acquired NMR, mass spectrometry (LC- and GC-MS, including high-resolution measurements and proteomics), and microscopy (AFM, confocal and fluorescence) instruments, GMO class 1 and 2 labs, flow cytometry, NTA, coulter counter, NGS, Q-PCR facilities, pipetting robots, calorimetry (ITC and DSC), chromatography (HPLC), and scattering (DLS, SAXS) instruments.
The post-doctoral position is within the Section of Molecular and Medical Biology: Molecular and Medical Biology | Roskilde University (ruc.dk)
Read more about the Department of Science and Environment at: https://ruc.dk/en/department-science-and-environment

Questions
For further information about the postdoc, please contact Professor Louise Dalgaard (tel. (+45) 4674 2713) or email: ltd@ruc.dk).

Terms of employment
The position is available from 1/5 2027. The employment is full time, and you will refer to Head of Department Susanne Sørensen.

The position will be filled according to the Agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. 

According to the Pay Transparency Directive, the salary ranges for the various job categories at Roskilde University are listed here. 

Application procedure 
After the deadline for applications the Head of Department will shortlist applicants for assessment with assistance from the recruitment committee including the chairperson of the assessment committee.

Shortly after the application deadline all applicants will be notified whether or not their application has been selected for assessment.

The shortlisted applicants will be informed about the composition of the assessment committee, and each applicant will be given the opportunity to comment on the composition of the committee and - later on - their assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed, all applicants will be informed of the outcome of their application.

Application 
To apply for the position go to www.ruc.dk/en/job/ 

Only applications in English are accepted.

Applications must include:

• CV

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Sustainability and Environmental Management
jobs.description:
Department of Science and Environment (DSE), Roskilde University, invites applications for a position as assistant professor in Sustainability and Environmental Management, from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is limited for a period of 4 years.

In announcing the position, DSE looks to strengthen its research in environmental sciences within the following fields: Sustainability transitions and circular economy in institutional and healthcare settings, sociotechnical systems analysis, behavioural and consumption analyses, the economic valuation of environmental and health externalities; and the wellbeing economy as a framework connecting these to the circular transition. The Department is interested in applicants who see large-scale, cross-sectoral shifts of this kind - spanning production and consumption systems - as necessary to address today's pressing environmental challenges across the natural- and social-scientific fields represented in the Section for Environmental Dynamics. The position is closely linked to and partly funded by an Innovation Fund Denmark grant for a newly initiated interdisciplinary research project ROUNDS: Rethinking the cost of care – including the cost of externalities in circular transitions. The project links human health risk assessment, ecological economics, and behavioural research to reduce reliance on single-use plastics and textiles in the healthcare sector.

The Department is interested in applicants whose research and teaching profile includes all the above subject areas in combination with an interest in building interdisciplinary research and collaboration on education. The Assistant Professor’s duties will comprise research at a high international level and a strong commitment and contribution to teaching broadly in the environmental science programs at bachelor’s and master’s level. The Assistant Professor will teach in an interdisciplinary environment and engage in problem-oriented project work with extensive student involvement and responsibility.

DSE is one of four departments at Roskilde University. The Department conducts basic and applied research within medical biology, molecular biology, environmental sciences, chemistry, physics, and mathematics. Bachelor and Master programmes are offered within these areas. Research and education within the fields take place in a collaborative and interdisciplinary university environment, also spanning collaboration with the other departments, covering social sciences and humanities, where relevant. The department is organised into four Sections comprising the research and education activities.

The Assistant Professor will be part of the Section for Environmental Dynamics. The Section’s current members primarily have a background within one or more of the fields of aquatic ecology, ecotoxicology, biological production (including aquatic biotechnology), and geochemistry. DSE has a well-established shared infrastructure with state-of-the-art equipment facilities, including field spectroradiometer, Mass-spectrometry (LCMS, GCMS, ICP-MS), CHNS, various microscopy facilities and access to workshops.

Read more about the section at https://ruc.dk/en/research-group/environmental-dynamics

Responsibilities and tasks
The assistant professor’s work will include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication, and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within one or more of the fields of the Assistant Professorship and in general activities at the environmental science programme activities.

In addition to research and research-based teaching, the position also requires sharing knowledge with the rest of society - including participation in public debate. To a limited extent, this may also include performance of other activities.

As assistant professor, you are also expected to complete the educational training program for assistant professors at RUC (up to 220 hours). The training programme will give you pedagogical and didactic tools as well as familiarize you with the Roskilde University educational model called Problem oriented project learning (PPL). Applicants are referred to the university’s Faculty expectations (https://ruc.dk/en/working-roskilde-university ) for specifications on the required level of qualifications within research, teaching, networking, fundraising, impact and outreach etc.

The ideal candidate is expected to:

• Lead and further develop research within the circular economy, sustainability transitions, and environmental management in institutional and healthcare settings, including engagement in the research project ROUNDS
• Develop the field of interdisciplinary research by actively collaborating with other scientific fields within the department or at other departments, connecting environmental science with social science and economics
• Contribute to the development of the research profile of the department
• Maintain a significant record of publications
• Collaborate with colleagues in establishing a vibrant research community
• Participate actively in research networks and external research funding activities
• Teach, supervise, and assess students at BSc and MSc levels. This also implies developing the field in relation to teaching
Qualifications
You must hold a PhD degree in Environmental Science or in the interface between the natural and social sciences applied to environmental and sustainability questions. In addition, a documented qualitative and/or interdisciplinary approach to sustainability transitions is required.

Documented research production at international level within one or more of the following scientific areas are required:

• Circular economy and sustainability transitions in institutional or healthcare settings
• Sociotechnical systems theory and analysis of organisational/infrastructural change
• Valuation of environmental and health externalities, including in relation to public procurement
The ideal candidate has:

• Teaching experience within one or more of the fields of the Associate Professor
• A keen interest and experience in project-based, problem-oriented teaching as well as teaching in an interdisciplinary environment
• Documented experience with interdisciplinary research and interdisciplinary collaborations will also be seen as an advantage.
In addition, it will be seen as an advantage if you can contribute to research and teaching within one or more of these areas:

• Environmental management and monitoring
• Political economy of sustainability transitions
• Health systems and behavioural aspects of circular practice
The ideal candidate must be enterprising, possess good communication skills, and be a visible and involved participant in the department’s daily activities, in addition to being willing to engage in disciplinary and interdisciplinary collaboration across the department.

At the time of appointment, successful candidates must master English for academic purposes.

Assessment
In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

• Relevance of research topic
• Scientific production at an international level
• Research prospective and the ability to promote and utilise research results
• Experience in teaching and education
• Other academic experience, e.g. from organising research conferences or seminars
• Ability to contribute to development of the department’s internal and external cooperation
Questions
Potential applicants from outside Denmark will find information about life in Denmark (taxation, healthcare etc.) at www.lifeindenmark.borger.dk

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Section Kristian Syberg on tel. (+45) 4674 3776 or e-mail: ksyberg@ruc.dk or Head of Department Susanne Sørensen by email: susa@ruc.dk.

Terms of employment
The employment is on full time, 37 hours per week and in the daily work you will refer to Professor Kristian Syberg. Your head of staff will be Head of Department Susanne Sørensen.

Application procedure

Shortly after the application deadline all applicants will be notified whether or not their application has been selected for assessment.

The shortlisted applicants will be informed about the composition of the assessment committee, and each applicant will be given the opportunity to comment on the composition of the committee and - later on - their assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed, all applicants will be informed of the outcome of their application.

Application

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay makes card payments simple and fair for small businesses. Marketing is central to how we grow, and we run it as a measurable acquisition engine where curiosity, experimentation and commercial results drive our decisions.

We are looking for an Affiliate & Partnerships Manager to lead our network of affiliates, publishers and lead generation partners across all of our markets.

The role

In six months, affiliate went from zero to one of our most important channels. Now we need someone to take it further.

You like meeting people, spotting opportunities and turning a good conversation into a partnership that performs. You can negotiate a strong deal and still leave the other side wanting to work with you again. And signing is only the start: you will follow each partnership through the funnel, understand what makes it profitable and make it better.

This is a group function. You will report to our Head of Group Marketing, work with colleagues across creative, paid media and analytics, and have real autonomy. We want fewer approval steps, not more. You will need to be self-driven, and in return you will learn a lot across teams and functions.

**What You'll Do

**

• Find new partners. Identify promising affiliates, publishers and lead generation partners, start the conversations and build a pipeline across our markets.

• Negotiate deals that last. Agree pricing, commission structures and terms that support profitable growth for us and a sustainable relationship for them.

• Turn good partners into great ones. Set clear expectations and help partners improve their campaigns, placements and results.

• Look beyond the lead. Follow the journey from lead to booked meeting to customer, and weigh acquisition cost against customer value.

• Make the call. Recommend when to scale, renegotiate, pause or end a partnership.

• Fix what is leaking. Work with partners, the analytics team and sales to find where performance breaks down, then test hypotheses.

• Own the roadmap and reporting. Set the partner roadmap, run onboarding, tracking and commission validation, and report on what the channel delivers.

• Work smarter with AI. Use AI as an assistant to find partners, analyse results and speed up daily work. It supports your judgement and never replaces it.

**How We Work

**

• Quality first, then scale. We would rather have fewer, better leads than many weak ones, but we are not afraid to test. One high-potential partner was trialled in one market and, two months later, was live in five and our biggest partner in the group.

• Shared decisions where it counts. You will set commission models and budgets together with the Head of Group Marketing, so we stay aligned across channels.

**Who You Are

**

• You have experience in affiliate marketing, performance partnerships or lead generation, with responsibility for partner relationships and measurable results.

• You are a strong negotiator who understands the other side’s incentives and can have a direct conversation when something needs to change.

• You are commercially sharp and comfortable turning data and spreadsheets into a clear recommendation.

• You are curious. You ask why, test your assumptions and change your mind when the evidence says so.

• You take initiative and follow through, and you are happy moving fast where not every process exists yet.

• You communicate clearly in English. Additional languages are a plus.

Experience with B2B lead generation, platforms such as Impact, Awin or PartnerStack, or tracking and attribution is an advantage. We can more about your judgement, results and ability to learn than about tool familiarity.

What we offer

• Real ownership of the partner roadmap and a direct hand in growing a channel that grows with the company

• Competitive salary based on your qualifications

• A central marketing team and a manager who will support your development

• Room to build processes, try new approaches and shape the future of affiliate at Flatpay

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Milestone Systems is a leading provider of data-driven video technology software. Our portfolio includes XProtect video management software, Arcules video surveillance as a service, and BriefCam analytics. We amplify what organizations of any size can see, do, and achieve with video. Guided by our People First mindset - freedom, inclusion, and togetherness - we always consider our employees, partners, and communities in everything we do.

Make an impact with us

At Milestone Systems, what you do matters. People are at the heart of everything we do, grounded in integrity, collaboration, strong relationships, and a curiosity that drives continuous learning. It is how we work together, learn from one another, embrace new perspectives, and create lasting impact.

In this role, you will be a trusted partner to managers and teams, helping them turn business priorities into value adding people actions. You will create impact through thoughtful coaching, strong relationships and the confidence to help managers build strong teams.

About the role

As People Partner, you will own the people partnership for your assigned business areas. You will work closely with managers, leadership teams and, when relevant, their teams to strengthen leadership, engagement, performance and organisational effectiveness.

You will report to the Head of People & Culture HQ and become part of our global People & Culture team, collaborating with colleagues across regions and specialist areas.

What makes this role interesting is the breadth. One day you may coach a manager through a sensitive performance conversation; the next, you may facilitate a leadership-team workshop, support a recruitment process or turn engagement insights into focused action. You will have room to influence, while staying close to the managers and teams you support.

What you will do

• Partner with managers, leadership teams and, when relevant, their teams to understand business priorities and translate them into focused people plans and actions.

• Coach and challenge managers on leadership dilemmas, team effectiveness, engagement, development and retention, building their confidence to lead well.

• Guide managers through employee relations and performance matters including difficult conversations, performance improvement plans, disciplinary issues and terminations, with clear documentation and sound judgement.

• Drive key people processes such as talent reviews, performance management, annual salary review and individual development follow-up.

• Use people data and insight including engagement results and workforce information, to identify priorities, support decisions and follow through on actions.

• Support organisation design, workforce planning and change by facilitating discussions, challenging assumptions and helping leaders make sustainable decisions.

• Support recruitment and facilitate team interventions by partnering with hiring managers on recruitments, and by planning and facilitating workshops for leadership teams and employee groups.

What you bring

We are looking for someone with:

• 5-8 years of experience as an HR Business Partner, People Partner or in a comparable broad people role, ideally in an international or matrix organisation.

• Strong experience coaching and advising managers at different levels, with the credibility to be supportive, candid and appropriately challenging.

• Hands-on experience with performance management and employee relations, including sensitive conversations, performance improvement and organisational change.

• A good understanding of talent, engagement, workforce planning, organisation design and reward processes, and how these areas connect to business outcomes.

• Strong facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with fluency in English.

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in HR, People & Culture, business or organisational development.

How you will make a difference

• You will thrive in this role if you are curious about the business, easy to work with and motivated by helping managers succeed rather than taking ownership away from them.

• You build trust quickly, keep momentum when topics are complex and can move comfortably between strategic perspective and hands-on support.

• You are decisive and comfortable working independently, while knowing that support and sparring from colleagues are always close at hand.

• You bring empathy to sensitive situations, but you are also clear, pragmatic and willing to challenge when it matters.

Meet the team

You’ll join People & Culture HQ, a collaborative team of 6, working closely with managers, employees and specialist colleagues across Milestone. We care about making People & Culture support useful, consistent and close to the business.

We share perspectives, help each other and keep things practical. You will have space to shape your partnerships and contribute to how our People Partner model continues to develop.

How we support you

At Milestone, we want you to have the opportunity to do meaningful work, develop your skills and grow your career.

We offer you:

• Individual development plans aligned with your career goals

• Access to training, learning resources, and certifications

• Flexible working arrangements

• Supportive leadership and regular feedback

• Opportunities for cross-functional and cross-regional collaboration

• Social activities and spaces to connect with colleagues

Ready to make an impact?

If you are excited about working closely with managers and teams, shaping meaningful people solutions and helping leaders navigate both opportunities and difficult moments, we would love to hear from you.

Questions about the role? Feel free to contact Head of People & Culture HQ, Britt Jørgensen, at brj@milestone.dk

Senior Utility Engineer – Plant Engineering (Søborg)

Keep life-changing therapies moving by keeping our utilities running.

Location: Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

AGC Biologics is expanding its Utility team in Søborg and is looking for an experienced Senior Utility Engineer with strong expertise in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical water systems. You will play an important role in ensuring the safe, reliable and compliant operation of utility systems that support our 24/7 research, development and production activities.

About the department

The Utility team is responsible for critical utility systems that support production and laboratory operations at our Søborg site. These include pharmaceutical water systems and other essential utilities. You will work closely with Production, QA, Validation, Maintenance and Project teams in a regulated environment where reliability, compliance and patient safety are key priorities.

The role

As Senior Utility Engineer, you will take technical ownership of GMP-critical water systems across the site. This is a hands-on, operational role focused on compliance, troubleshooting, risk reduction and continuous improvement. You will work alongside two skilled technicians who carry out scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, while you focus on system performance, technical oversight and long-term improvements.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the stable, compliant and efficient operation of pharmaceutical water systems.

• Taking technical ownership of systems and driving improvements to reliability and performance.

• Maintaining technical documentation, including SOPs, P&IDs and maintenance plans, in line with GMP requirements.

• Leading troubleshooting, root cause analysis, risk assessments and CAPA activities.

• Supporting commissioning, qualification and handover of utility projects to Operations and Maintenance.

• Providing technical input to CAPEX and OPEX projects.

• Representing Utilities during audits and inspections.

• Acting as the senior technical contact for water systems and providing guidance to colleagues across the site.

Most work takes place during regular business hours, although occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support our 24/7 production environment.

Initially, your primary focus will be pharmaceutical water systems. Over time, your responsibilities may expand to include black and clean utilities, allowing you to contribute more broadly across the Utility team.

Experience and competences

We are looking for an experienced Senior Utility Engineer with substantial experience working with pharmaceutical water systems in a GMP-regulated environment.

To succeed in the role, you have:

• An engineering degree in mechanical, electrical or chemical engineering, or a similar field, or an equivalent technical background combined with relevant experience.

• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical water systems and applicable GMP/GxP requirements.

• Experience with troubleshooting, maintenance and optimisation of technical systems.

• Experience with technical documentation, deviations, CAPAs, risk assessments and regulatory inspections.

• The ability to take technical ownership, solve complex problems and drive improvements independently.

• The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information clearly.

Experience with GMP utilities, project handovers, black and clean utilities, regulatory audits and mentoring colleagues is an advantage.

As a person, you are

You are proactive, independent and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities. You are structured and solution-oriented, with a strong focus on quality and compliance. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and enjoy sharing knowledge with colleagues. You are comfortable balancing operational priorities with technical documentation and continuous improvement.

AGC offers

At AGC Biologics, you will work with critical utility systems in a dynamic pharmaceutical production environment. You will join a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, ownership and practical problem-solving are valued. The role offers the opportunity to develop your technical expertise and contribute to the reliable operation of systems that support our production activities around the clock.

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.description:
Student Assistant for Supply Chain & Logistics, Salling Group

_Are you an ambitious student looking to gain insight into logistics in Denmark’s largest retail organisation? Are you ready to combine your theoretical knowledge with practical experience and make a difference in a young and dynamic team?

_We are looking for an engaged Student Assistant to join our Logistics Development & Support department at Salling Group. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills and put theory into practice. As part of the team, you will contribute to optimising the journey of goods from our central warehouses to the shelves in Salling Group’s stores.

Your responsibilities

• Analyse large datasets to optimise flows and processes

• Support both large and small projects across Supply Chain & Logistics

• Take part in the daily operations of our Inbound Handling team

• Ad hoc tasks

Who are you?

We imagine that you will start a cand.merc. this summer, preferably in Operations and Supply Chain Analytics. You have strong Excel skills, and experience with VBA, Python or similar programming languages is an advantage. You are fluent in written and spoken English and thrive in a collaborative environment where humour is a natural part of everyday life.

We are looking for a responsible and reliable person who is comfortable taking ownership of projects and is motivated to make a difference. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and have an interest in logistics and optimisation. With strong analytical skills and a structured approach to your work, you are able to work independently while building strong relationships across the organisation.

What we offer

• The opportunity to apply your theoretical knowledge in practice

• A young and talented team where sparring and development are prioritised

• A varied working day with great colleagues and the opportunity to build a broad network across Salling Group

• Insight into day-to-day warehouse operations through project work and internal inspiration visits

• Opportunities for an internship and collaboration on your Master’s thesis

Practical information

We expect you to work an average of 16 hours per week, with flexibility during exam periods. The position is based in Aarslev, Aarhus.

Please upload your application, CV, transcript of grades and any relevant references no later than Sunday, 22 November 2026. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. Start date is as soon as possible, with the position continuing until the completion of your master’s degree.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Senior Logistics Developer, Camilla Enevoldsen, on +45 22 99 40 09.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Based at our welcoming Roskilde office, you will join the Workplace department, which develops and maintains BEC’s cloud-based Microsoft platform, including SharePoint and Microsoft 365 administration services, for BEC and our 25 Danish banking customers.

As a Senior Microsoft 365 Platform/System Engineer, you will join a team of dedicated professionals focused on developing SharePoint and Microsoft 365 within our Modern Workplace services.

You will be part of a cross-country, agile Microsoft 365 team comprising 12 dedicated professionals.

At BEC, we value regular in-office collaboration while offering flexibility to work remotely for up to eight days per month. You will report to Anne-Mette Bluhme.

Your primary tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Administering and maintaining the Microsoft 365 suite, including Copilot, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams and OneDrive for Business

• Ensuring the availability, performance, and security of these services

• Implementing and managing security controls for Microsoft 365 environments, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

• Participation in development projects of new services

• Developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts to automate administrative tasks and improve efficiency

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• Solid experience administering Microsoft 365 services

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, and Copilot

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Customer-oriented thinking and high-quality standards

• The ability to collaborate effectively across functions and teams

It would also be an advantage to have:

• Experience in the financial sector

Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Referral bonus

What does the recruitment process look like?

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Development Manager Anne-Mette Bluhme at abz@bec.dk.

Join a community of people sharing great ambitions
